mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month upward trend in the federal funds rate compresses liquidity and increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with rising FEDFUNDS (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.6% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.6% (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side economic slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO decline periods, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS growth) indicates strong job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS grows (Rank IC < 0.05 or t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential construction (HOUST) signal a synchronized economic slowdown that depresses corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO-HOUST decline interaction fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized > 2.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to aggressive monetary policy expectations.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL annualized > 2.5% periods, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).
